description.zh: 资源ID列表。N 的取值范围为：1~50
description.en: The list of resource IDs. Valid values of N: 1 to 50.

description.zh:
资源类型定义。取值范围：
- Job
- Executor
description.en:
The type of the resource. Valid values:

*   Job
*   Executor

description.zh: 标签列表，最多包含20个子项。
description.en: The tags to add to the replication pair-consistent group. You can specify up to 20 tags.

description.zh: 标签键。一旦传入该值，则不允许为空字符串。最多支持 128 个字符，不能以 aliyun 和 acs:开头，不能包含 http://或 https://。
description.en: The key of the tag. The tag key cannot be an empty string. The tag key can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot contain http:// or https://. The tag key cannot start with acs: or aliyun.

description.zh: 标签值。一旦传入该值，可以为空字符串。最多支持 128 个字符，不能包含 http://或者 https://。
description.en: The value of the tag. You can specify empty strings as tag values. The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot contain http:// or https://.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ehpcinstant tag-resources --resource-type Job --resource-id job-xxxxxxxx --tag Value=TestValue Key=TestKey --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ehpcinstant TagResources --region cn-hangzhou --ResourceId.1 'job-xxxxxxxx' --Tag.1.Key TestKey --Tag.1.Value TestValue --ResourceType Job
